prompt: I'm thinking of the  screenplay, co-wrote by the same author as Lonesome Dove, that won an Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay 20 years after Lonesome Dove won the Pulitzer Prize. What was the name of the screenplay?
answer: The screenplay was **_Brokeback Mountain_**, co-written by **Larry McMurtry and Diana Ossana**. It won the **2006 Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay**, 20 years after _Lonesome Dove_ won the 1986 Pulitzer Prize for Fiction.
